name: Tokuyasu cryo-ultramicrotomy of 2.3 M sucrose-infused cell pellets: trimming at -100 °C, 50-80 nm sections at -120 °C (Leica UC7/FC7)
plain_name: Cut ultra-thin frozen slices of cells for antibody gold labelling
description: Gelatin-embedded cell pellets (about 1 mm cubes) are infused with 2.3 M sucrose, frozen in liquid nitrogen on aluminium pins, trimmed at -100 °C and sectioned at -120 °C into 50-80 nm ultrathin cryosections in a cryo-ultramicrotome, then thawed for immunogold labelling and TEM.
keywords: Cut ultra-thin frozen slices of cells for antibody gold labelling

sources.citation: De Mazière A, van der Beek J, van Dijk S, de Heus C, Reggiori F, Koike M, Klumperman J (2022). An optimized protocol for immuno-electron microscopy of endogenous LC3. Autophagy. doi:10.1080/15548627.2022.2056864

requirements.rationale: Trimming at -100 °C and ultrathin sectioning at -120 °C.
Ultrathin cryosections of 50-80 nm are required.
Blocks are frozen and stored in liquid nitrogen before cryosectioning.
About 1 mm cubic blocks; circumscribed diameter of a 1 mm x 1 mm face is 1.414 mm (rounded up).
